The '''captain''' of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Sarapin Wanderer]]'' was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Unidentified space battle (Oteg)|battle]] in the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
